$description: Strata design tokens. Defaults per docs/ui-library/design-language.md. Values with `anchors` blend with `depth` (0%, 50%, 100%); `min`/`max` are validated ranges; `scope: false` means application-level only.

azimuth.$description: Where the light comes from, degrees clockwise from the top of the screen.

elevation.$description: Light height above the panel plane, degrees.

distance.$description: Minimum camera distance; validation raises it to satisfy the taper rule.

gain.$description: How strongly bevel normals catch and lose the light.

profile.$description: Bevel cross-section: quarter-round, chamfer or cove.

max.$description: Largest brightness change on a face interior (keeps text contrast).

hoverLift.$description: Interior brightening on hover (clamped by interior.max).

pressSink.$description: Interior darkening while pressed (clamped by interior.max).

taper.$description: Inset of raised tops; validated to be at least the perspective drift.

sweep.$description: The cap's turn from minimum to maximum, in degrees.

dragPx.$description: Vertical drag for a full sweep.

fine.$description: The drag rate while Shift is held.

tapSlop.$description: A press that moves less than this is a tap.

snap.$description: A ring click within this many degrees of a printed numeral sets exactly its value.

meter.$description: Meter interaction and layout (section 14, Instrument controls): the needle meter's arc and the peak hold of a bar.

sweep.$description: The needle meter's arc from minimum to maximum, in degrees.

peakHold.$description: How long a held peak stays where it was set before it starts to fall.

peakDecay.$description: How fast a held peak falls, in shares of the range a second.

sweep.$description: The needle's turn from minimum to maximum, in degrees.

jog.$description: JogWheel interaction (section 14, Instrument controls): the endless wheel whose value steps and whose dimple turns on an accumulated angle.

turn.$description: Steps in one turn of the wheel: its angle per step is 360 over this.

dragPx.$description: Vertical drag for one turn of the wheel (the alternative to a circular drag).

fine.$description: The drag rate while Shift is held.

tapSlop.$description: A press that moves less than this is a tap.

flick.$description: The release speed, in degrees a second, under which the wheel stops where it was let go; over it, it coasts on spring.jog.

maxRate.$description: The most steps a second a coasting wheel applies: each is one native step and one input event.

material.$description: Open, layered materials: presets, roles, and any custom materials an application adds (design-language.md section 4).

lacquer.$description: Glass-coated: a clear, glossy top layer.

source.$description: studio (generated in code), none, or the URL of an .hdr or .env file.

edge.$description: Boundaries of wells, tracks and knobs: at least 3:1 against the lit panel.

glowOn.$description: Lit lenses, rings and flags: the Lamp's default colour.

base.$description: Spacing unit; space.1 to space.10 are 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12 units.

size.$description: Component sizes (section 13): data-strata-size="small", "medium" (default) or "large" on a component or a scope.

small.$description: Fader travel (the carriage centre's path) at small.

medium.$description: Fader travel (the carriage centre's path) at medium (the premium fader).

large.$description: Fader travel (the carriage centre's path) at large.

small.$description: Checkbox and radio box, and switch track height, at small.

medium.$description: Checkbox and radio box, and switch track height, at medium.

large.$description: Checkbox and radio box, and switch track height, at large.

small.$description: Change to the density's control height at small.

medium.$description: Change to the density's control height at medium.

large.$description: Change to the density's control height at large.

medium.$description: Knob skirt diameter at medium (the premium knob).
Lamp lens diameter at medium (the premium lamp).
StatusLight lens diameter at medium (the premium LED).

small.$description: Meter segment lens diameter at small.

medium.$description: Meter segment lens diameter at medium (the premium LED segment).

large.$description: Meter segment lens diameter at large.

medium.$description: Gauge dial diameter at medium (the premium gauge).
JogWheel diameter at medium (the premium jog wheel).
PatchPoint washer diameter at medium (the premium jack).

normal.$description: Switch throw, key travel, small panels.

offset.$description: Focus indicator offset outside the shape.

snap.$description: A track click released within this distance of a printed mark sets exactly its value.

width.$description: Outline on raised faces (controls, cards, panels). 0 except in the high-contrast themes, where relief is off and the outline carries every shape.

feedback.$description: Feedback (section 20): opt-in synthesised sound and haptics, off by default, per application or scope; and the premium sound set, three parameters per sound.

sound.$description: Synthesised sound on Instrument controls: 1 on, 0 off (the default). Sound starts only after a user gesture and is never the only feedback.

haptics.$description: A vibration pulse on Instrument controls, where the device has one: 1 on, 0 off (the default). Off under reduced motion.

click.$description: A push button's press and release.

decay.$description: How fast the click dies away, ms (its envelope's time constant; the sound lasts five of them).

noise.$description: How much of the click is noise rather than tone, 0–1.

decay.$description: How fast the tick dies away, ms (its envelope's time constant; the sound lasts five of them).

noise.$description: How much of the tick is noise rather than tone, 0–1.

decay.$description: How fast the thunk dies away, ms (its envelope's time constant; the sound lasts five of them).

noise.$description: How much of the thunk is noise rather than tone, 0–1.

snap.$description: A lever, rocker or paddle thrown.

decay.$description: How fast the snap dies away, ms (its envelope's time constant; the sound lasts five of them).

noise.$description: How much of the snap is noise rather than tone, 0–1.

level.$description: Presentation level: relief (default), objects, instrument, scene.

blink.$description: StatusLight blink tempos (section 14): one full on-off cycle; never faster than 334 ms, so a light flashes at most three times a second (WCAG 2.3.1). Off under reduced motion.

slow.$description: A slow blink: 0.6 flashes a second.

normal.$description: A steady blink: 1 flash a second.

fast.$description: A fast blink: 2.5 flashes a second.

emitter.$description: Emitters (section 3): the light a lit lamp or LED gives. Radius and height are in lens diameters; strength is for the reference lens (28 px for a lamp, 10 px for an LED) and scales with the square of the lens.

height.$description: Height above the face, in lens diameters.

strength.$description: Intensity I at the reference lens.

height.$description: Height above the face, in lens diameters.

strength.$description: Intensity I at the reference lens.

radius.$description: Reach R of a lit meter segment, in lens diameters (a bar throws many small pools, so each reaches less than an LED's).

height.$description: Height above the face, in lens diameters.

strength.$description: Intensity I at the reference lens (10 px).

guardFeather.$description: Width over which the guard eases off outside a protected rect.
